rules.msg: targetSdk is {found}. Google Play requires API level 36 for new apps and for updates to existing apps from 31 August 2026 ({days}). Below that, Play will not accept the upload.
rules.fix: Set targetSdk 36 in defaultConfig, then work through the Android 16 behaviour changes flagged below. An extension can be requested in Play Console until 1 November 2026.

rules.msg: This module has a defaultConfig block but no targetSdk. Gradle falls back to compileSdk, so the value Play sees is not the one written here.
rules.fix: Declare targetSdk 36 explicitly in defaultConfig so the value is reviewable in the diff.

rules.msg: compileSdk is {found}. You cannot set targetSdk 36 while compiling against {found} — the Android 16 APIs the new behaviour needs are not on the classpath.
rules.fix: Raise compileSdk to 36 first, fix the deprecation errors, then raise targetSdk.

rules.msg: Android Gradle Plugin {found} is on the 7.x line or older. AGP 8 is the floor for building against recent platform SDKs; 7.x cannot compile a targetSdk 36 module.
rules.fix: Upgrade the AGP dependency to the 8.x line and raise the Gradle wrapper to match before touching targetSdk.

rules.msg: The edge-to-edge opt-out is still in the manifest (windowOptOutEdgeToEdgeEnforcement / PROPERTY_COMPAT_ALLOW_OPT_OUT_EDGE_TO_EDGE). On Android 16 it is ignored for apps targeting API 36 — your content will draw under the status and navigation bars on the day you raise targetSdk.
rules.fix: Remove the opt-out and handle insets: apply WindowInsetsCompat padding to the root view, or set android:fitsSystemWindows on it.

rules.msg: android:screenOrientation="{found}" is declared. For apps targeting API 36, orientation restrictions are ignored on displays wider than 600dp — tablets, foldables and desktop windowing will rotate and resize your locked screen anyway.
rules.fix: Stop relying on the lock: test the activity in landscape and in a resized window, and keep state across configuration changes.

rules.msg: android:resizeableActivity="false" is declared. For apps targeting API 36 this is ignored on large screens, so the activity will be resized regardless.
rules.fix: Remove the attribute and make the layout responsive, or accept that the system will resize it on tablets and foldables.

rules.msg: <{tag}> has an intent-filter but no android:exported. Since API 31 this is a hard build failure, not a warning.
rules.fix: Add android:exported="true" if another app or the launcher must start it, android:exported="false" otherwise.

rules.msg: FOREGROUND_SERVICE is requested but no service declares android:foregroundServiceType. From API 34, starting a foreground service without a declared type throws MissingForegroundServiceTypeException at runtime.
rules.fix: Add android:foregroundServiceType to each <service> that calls startForeground, and request the matching FOREGROUND_SERVICE_* permission.

rules.msg: foregroundServiceType="{found}" is declared but android.permission.{perm} is not requested. From API 34 the matching permission is required or the service will not start.
Play Billing Library {found} is below version 7. Google Play's billing library floor moved to 7 for app updates and it rises on its own annual schedule, separate from the targetSdk deadline.
rules.fix: Upgrade com.android.billingclient:billing and re-test the purchase flow — the 6 to 7 jump changed the product-details and subscription APIs.

rules.msg: ndkVersion is r{found}. 16 KB page size support arrived in NDK r27, and Play requires 16 KB compatible native code for apps targeting Android 15 and above.
rules.fix: Move to NDK r27 or newer and rebuild every prebuilt .so you ship, including the ones inside third-party AARs.

rules.msg: useLegacyPackaging is true, so native libraries ship compressed and unaligned. That is the opposite of what 16 KB page size devices need.
rules.fix: Set useLegacyPackaging false and confirm your native libs load on a 16 KB emulator image.

rules.msg: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is requested. From Android 14 it is denied by default for most apps, and Play's exact alarm policy requires a declared use case that Play accepts.
rules.fix: Use WorkManager or setAndAllowWhileIdle if the timing can slip; keep the exact alarm only if you file the Play declaration and can defend it.

rules.msg: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is requested. Play's All files access policy needs a separate declaration and grants it to a narrow set of app types.
rules.fix: Move to scoped storage, MediaStore or the Storage Access Framework unless you are a file manager or backup app.

rules.msg: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES is requested. Play treats it as sensitive and requires a declaration form; most submissions that use it to check for one or two apps are told to use a <queries> element instead.
rules.fix: Replace it with a <queries> block naming the packages or intents you actually resolve.

rules.msg: android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" is set application-wide, so every HTTP call in the app is permitted in plaintext.
rules.fix: Drop the attribute and scope any remaining plaintext host to a network security config file.
